title: Tella is SOC 2 Type II Compliant
summary: Is Tella SOC 2 compliant? Yes. Tella is SOC 2 Type II compliant, verified by an independent auditor. Request the report under NDA at trust.tella.com.
body_markdown:
Tella is SOC 2 Type II compliant. Prescient Assurance, an independent auditor, tested our security controls over a three-month observation period, from June 4 to September 4, 2026, and has issued our report.


Security has always been a priority at Tella. The videos you record often hold unreleased products, customer conversations and internal plans, and we've built Tella to protect them. Now, continuous monitoring through[Oneleet](https://www.oneleet.com/) and formal policies keep our security posture up to date every day.


SOC 2 Type II goes further than Type I. Instead of checking our controls on a single day, the auditor tested that they ran over months of normal work. We'll be audited again every year to keep the report current.


Customers on[Enterprise plans](https://www.tella.com/enterprise) , and teams evaluating Tella, can request a copy of the report at[trust.tella.com](https://trust.tella.com/) after a conversation with our[sales team](https://www.tella.com/enterprise) . We share it under NDA.


Johnny, John and the Tella Team
